name: LangGraph
summary: LangChain 1.x create_agent (a compiled LangGraph tool-calling graph) with ChatAnthropic, MCP tools from langchain-mcp-adapters' MultiServerMCPClient and a native @tool.
notes: Uses langchain.agents.create_agent, the agent API LangChain 1.x documents (langgraph.prebuilt.create_react_agent's state types are deprecated in its favour). create_agent pins recursion_limit to 9,999, so max_turns is enforced with LangChain's ModelCallLimitMiddleware(run_limit=max_turns, exit_behavior='end'), which caps model calls 1:1. The spec's MCP entries pass straight into MultiServerMCPClient ('http' is its alias for streamable_http; stdio works the same way); get_tools() without a session opens a fresh MCP session per tool call. ChatAnthropic reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY/ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL itself and sends no temperature, tool_choice or cache_control by default (so no prompt caching), and a plain-string system prompt. No shims needed.
